datasource_item.source_question_text:
A Chinook salmon can jump out of water with a speed v0 and an angle 𝜃 above the horizontal. What is the speed of the fish when it is at the maximum height?
A. 𝑣0. [incorrect]
B. 𝑣0 cos𝜃. [correct]
C. 𝑣0 sin𝜃. [incorrect]
D. 0. [incorrect]
datasource_item.generated_question_text:

the horizontal (ignore air resistance). What is the speed of the ball when it is
at maximum height?
A. u0. [incorrect] Explanation: The speed is not generally unchanged because the vertical component decreases to zero.
B. u0 cos ϕ. [correct] Explanation: At the top the vertical velocity is zero, so the speed equals the constant horizontal component
u0 cos ϕ.
C. u0 sin ϕ. [incorrect] Explanation: This is the initial vertical component, which becomes zero at maximum height.
D. 0. [incorrect] Explanation: Only the vertical component becomes zero at the top; the horizontal component remains
nonzero.
